decisions.decision: SW2 will reduce duplicate scans, regeneration, and validation work rather than remove required final governance gates.
decisions.rationale: The user requires substantially faster development without weakening evidence-based acceptance.
decisions.title: Keep governance strict while optimizing execution

decisions.decision: V2 will preserve complete machine evidence while allowing bounded, semantic human documentation views.
decisions.rationale: Current sequence and symbol outputs can be structurally useful to validators but too large or low-level for public human consumption.
decisions.title: Separate machine evidence from human-facing documentation

decisions.decision: Skill Workflow will adopt its own governed roadmap, project truth, generated docs, and acceptance workflow before engine V2 refactoring begins.
decisions.rationale: A governance framework should prove that its contract is practical on itself before expanding it for consumers.
decisions.title: Dogfood Skill Workflow on its own repository

decisions.decision: Governance Engine V2 may reuse one immutable source snapshot and process-local derived facts only within one execution. Snapshot or memoized state is never acceptance authority; final acceptance starts a fresh process, recaptures the exact candidate source, and reruns required evidence.
decisions.rationale: Repeated source discovery, file reads, AST extraction, and nested script processes are avoidable execution cost, but persisting cache state as truth would weaken provenance and fail-closed semantics.
decisions.title: Keep snapshot reuse process-local and non-authoritative
